IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r1.claim: Ḥudhayfa reports that, after transmitters and non-Arab readers spread across regions, Iraqi and Syrian groups disputed their readings in the Armenia campaign; some disavowed others’ recitations.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r1.anchor: وذلك أنهم لما اجتمعوا في غزوة أرمينية، فقرأت كل طائفة بما روي لها، فاختلفوا وتنازعوا حتى قال بعضهم لبعض: «أنا كافر بما تقرأ به»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r2.speaker: حذيفة بن اليمان
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r2.claim: On returning to Medina, Ḥudhayfa urged ʿUthmān to act on the Book before the community split like Jews and Christians; ʿUthmān agreed to intervene.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r2.anchor: فقال: أدرك هذه الأمة قبل أن تهلك

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r3.speaker: عثمان بن عفان
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r3.claim: ʿUthmān appointed capable, learned, eloquent men to prepare a codex, choosing among transmitted variants the best-known Prophetic readings and most eloquent language.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r3.anchor: فتجرد للأمر، واستناب الكفاة العلماء الفصحاء في أن يكتبوا القرآن ويجعلوا ما اختلفت القراءة فيه على أشهر الروايات عن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وأفصح اللغات

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r4.speaker: عثمان بن عفان
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r4.claim: ʿUthmān instructed the scribes to use Quraysh’s language when they differed.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r4.anchor: وقال لهم: «إذا اختلفتم في شيء فاكتبوه بلغة قريش»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r5.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya explains that if you differ concerns differences in transmitted readings; every one of the seven language forms in the Qurʾān must derive from the Prophet and have been recited to him.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r5.anchor: فمعنى هذا إذا اختلفتم فيما روي، وإلا فمحال أن يحيلهم على اختلاف من قبلهم، لأنه وضع قرآن فكتبوا في القرآن من كل اللغات السبع

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r6.claim: The community followed the selected codex and set aside variant codices to prevent further division and preserve unity.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r6.anchor: واستمر الناس على هذا المصحف المتخير وترك ما خرج عنه مما كان كتب سدا للذريعة وتغليبا لمصلحة الألفة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r7.claim: Ibn Masʿūd resisted replacing his codex, so it was left; scholars nevertheless barred reciting from it to prevent confusion, since explanatory notes were reportedly mistaken for Qurʾān.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r7.anchor: فأما ابن مسعود فأبى أن يزال مصحفه فترك، ولكن أبى العلماء قراءته سدا للذريعة، ولأنه روي أنه كتب فيه أشياء على جهة التفسير فظنها قوم من التلاوة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r8.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r8.claim: No Qurʾānic meaning was lost when noncanonical wording was left out, because the meanings remain in the established text.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v1p47/r8.anchor: ولم يسقط فيما ترك معنى من معاني القرآن لأن المعنى جزء من الشريعة، وإنما تركت ألفاظ معانيها موجودة في الذي أثبت

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r1.speaker: حذيفة بن اليمان
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r1.claim: During the Armenia and Azerbaijan campaigns, Ḥudhayfa heard Syrian and Iraqi Muslims differing in their recitations and warned ʿUthmān to act before the community divided over scripture as Jews and Christians had.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r1.anchor: فأفزع حذيفة اختلافهم في القراءة. فقال حذيفة لعثمان: يا أمير المؤمنين، أدرك هذه الأمة قبل أن يختلفوا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r2.speaker: عثمان بن عفان
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r2.claim: ʿUthmān borrowed Ḥafṣa’s pages and commissioned Zayd ibn Thābit, ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Zubayr, Saʿīd ibn al-ʿĀṣ, and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥārith to copy them into codices.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r2.anchor: فأمر زيد بن ثابت وعبد الله بن الزبير وسعيد بن العاص وعبد الرحمن بن الحارث بن هشام فنسخوها في المصاحف

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r3.speaker: عثمان بن عفان
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r3.claim: ʿUthmān instructed the three Qurashī copyists to use Quraysh’s speech whenever they and Zayd disagreed, because the Qur’an was revealed in that dialect; the official copies were sent to the regions and other codices burned.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r3.anchor: إذا اختلفتم أنتم وزيد بن ثابت في شيء من القرآن فاكتبوه بلسان قريش، فإنما أنزل بلسانهم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r4.speaker: زيد بن ثابت
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r4.claim: Zayd says the copyists noticed a verse missing from al-Aḥzāb that he had heard the Prophet recite; they found it with Khuzayma ibn Thābit and inserted it in its sūra.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r4.anchor: سمع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقرأ بها، التمسناها فوجدناها مع خزيمة بن ثابت الأنصاري: {من المؤمنين رجال صدقوا ما عاهدوا الله عليه}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r5.claim: Ibn Kathir counts ʿUthmān’s unification of the community on one reading among his greatest merits; Abū Bakr and ʿUmar had earlier collected the Qur’an to prevent any part from being lost.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r5.anchor: وهذا -أيضا-من أكبر مناقب أمير المؤمنين عثمان بن عفان، رضي الله عنه، فإن الشيخين سبقاه إلى حفظ القرآن

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r6.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r6.claim: The Companions all agreed with ʿUthmān’s decision; Ibn Masʿūd initially showed anger because he was not among the codex copyists and told his followers to conceal their codices, but later returned to agreement.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r7.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r7.claim: ʿAlī said that had ʿUthmān not taken this step, he would have done it himself.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r7.anchor: حتى قال علي بن أبي طالب، رضي الله عنه: لو لم يفعل ذلك عثمان لفعلته أنا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r8.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r8.claim: Ibn Kathir cites the Prophet’s instruction to follow his Sunnah and the Sunnah of the rightly guided caliphs in support of their united decision.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27#2/r8.anchor: وهم الخلفاء الذين قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: " عليكم بسنتي وسنة الخلفاء الراشدين من بعدي "

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r1.speaker: مصعب بن سعد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r1.claim: Musʿab b. Saʿd reports that ʿUthmān responded to reading disputes by collecting written Qurʾan fragments, checking each against the Prophet’s dictation, assigning Saʿīd to dictate and Zayd to write; Ibn Kathīr grades the chain ṣaḥīḥ.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r1.anchor: عن أبي إسحاق، عن مصعب بن سعد قال: قام عثمان فخطب الناس فقال

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r2.speaker: كثير بن أفلح
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r2.claim: Kathīr b. Aflah reports that ʿUthmān assembled twelve Qurashī and Anṣārī men, including Ubayy and Zayd, and brought the collected sheets; Ibn Kathīr calls this report ṣaḥīḥ.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r2.anchor: عن كثير بن أفلح قال: لما أراد عثمان أن يكتب المصاحف جمع له اثني عشر رجلا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r3.speaker: محمد بن سيرين
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r3.claim: Ibn Sīrīn conjectures that the group delayed disputed material so they could identify who had most recently heard the final presentation and write accordingly.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r3.anchor: قال محمد: فظننت ظنا أنما كانوا يؤخرونها لينظروا أحدثهم عهدا بالعرضة الأخيرة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r4.claim: Ibn Kathīr clarifies that the collected sheets were with Ḥafṣa; ʿUthmān used them to compile the codex, then returned them to her as promised rather than burning them.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r4.anchor: قلت: الربعة هي الكتب المجتمعة، وكانت عند حفصة، رضي الله عنها

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r5.claim: After Ḥafṣa died, Marwān b. al-Ḥakam took and burned the sheets, adopting the rationale ʿUthmān had used for destroying other copies.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p32/r5.anchor: ثم أخذها مروان بن الحكم فحرقها

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r1.claim: When an explanation is absent from the Qurʾan, Sunna, and Companions, many imams turn to the Successors; Ibn Kathīr names Mujāhid, Saʿīd b. Jubayr, ʿIkrima, ʿAṭāʾ, al-Ḥasan, and others.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r1.anchor: فقد رجع كثير من الأئمة في ذلك إلى أقوال التابعين، كمجاهد بن جبر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r2.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r2.claim: Mujāhid says he recited the entire muṣḥaf to Ibn ʿAbbās three times, stopping at every verse to ask its interpretation.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r2.anchor: قال محمد بن إسحاق: حدثنا أبان بن صالح، عن مجاهد، قال: عرضت المصحف على ابن عباس ثلاث عرضات

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r3.speaker: ابن أبي مليكة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r3.claim: Ibn Abī Mulayka says he saw Mujāhid ask Ibn ʿAbbās for the Qurʾan’s interpretation with writing tablets; Ibn ʿAbbās told him to write until he had asked about all of it.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r3.anchor: عن ابن أبي مليكة قال: رأيت مجاهدا سأل ابن عباس عن تفسير القرآن، ومعه ألواحه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r4.speaker: سفيان الثوري
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r4.claim: Sufyān al-Thawrī regarded an interpretation transmitted from Mujāhid as sufficient.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r4.anchor: ولهذا كان سفيان الثوري يقول: إذا جاءك التفسير عن مجاهد فحسبك به

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r5.claim: Apparent differences in Successor wording often are not real disagreements: one may state an implication or equivalent, while another states the point directly.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r5.anchor: فإن منهم من يعبر عن الشيء بلازمه أو بنظيره، ومنهم من ينص على الشيء بعينه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r6.speaker: شعبة بن الحجاج
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r6.claim: Shuʿba b. al-Ḥajjāj and others argue that Successors’ legal opinions are not binding evidence for others, asking how they could be binding in tafsīr.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r6.anchor: وقال شعبة بن الحجاج وغيره: أقوال التابعين في الفروع ليست حجة؟ فكيف تكون حجة في التفسير؟

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r7.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r7.claim: Ibn Kathīr agrees Successor opinions do not bind those who disagree, but consensus is evidence; where they differ, none overrides another, so consult Qurʾanic usage, Sunna, Arabic usage, and Companions’ views.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r7.anchor: أما إذا أجمعوا على الشيء فلا يرتاب في كونه حجة، فإن اختلفوا فلا يكون بعضهم حجة على بعض

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r8.speaker: النبي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r8.claim: A report from Ibn ʿAbbās attributes to the Prophet a warning that whoever interprets the Qurʾan by opinion or without knowledge should take his seat in the Fire; Ibn Kathīr cites it to prohibit such tafsīr.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p10/r8.anchor: عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: " من قال في القرآن برأيه، أو بما لا يعلم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r1.speaker: أنس بن مالك
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r1.claim: Anas reports that ʿUthmān assigned Zayd, Saʿīd b. al-ʿĀṣ, Ibn al-Zubayr, and ʿAbd al-Raḥmān b. al-Ḥārith to copy codices, directing them to use Quraysh speech if they and Zayd differed in Qurʾanic Arabic.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r1.anchor: عن الزهري: أخبرني أنس بن مالك قال: فأمر عثمان بن عفان زيد بن ثابت وسعيد بن العاص

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r2.claim: Ibn Kathīr says al-Bukhārī’s point is that the Qurʾan was revealed in Quraysh’s language, and Quraysh were the foremost branch of the Arabs.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r2.anchor: ومقصود البخاري منه ظاهر، وهو أن القرآن نزل بلغة قريش، وقريش خلاصة العرب

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r3.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r3.claim: ʿUmar reportedly said only Qurashī or Thaqafī youths should dictate in the official codices; Ibn Kathīr grades the chain ṣaḥīḥ.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r3.anchor: عن جابر بن سمرة، قال: سمعت عمر بن الخطاب يقول: لا يملي في مصاحفنا هذه إلا غلمان قريش أو غلمان ثقيف

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r4.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r4.claim: Another report says ʿUmar instructed his committee to use the language of Muḍar when linguistic differences arose, because the Qurʾan came in the language of a man from Muḍar, the Prophet.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r4.anchor: قال: إذا اختلفتم في اللغة فاكتبوها بلغة مضر، فإن القرآن نزل بلغة رجل من مضر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r5.claim: Ibn Kathīr cites verses describing the Qurʾan as Arabic and revealed in clear Arabic as evidence for its language, also citing the challenge about a non-Arabic Qurʾan.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r5.anchor: وقد قال الله تعالى: {قرءانا عربيا غير ذي عوج لعلهم يتقون}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r6.speaker: يعلى بن أمية
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r6.claim: Yaʿlā b. Umayya wished to witness revelation; when a man in iḥrām wearing perfume and a cloak asked about ʿumra, ʿUmar brought Yaʿlā close to observe the Prophet receive revelation, after which the Prophet ordered the cloak removed and perfume washed away.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p23/r6.anchor: حديث يعلى بن أمية أنه كان يقول: ليتني أرى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم حين ينزل عليه الوحي

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p65#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p65#2/r1.speaker: عبد الله بن عمر
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p65#2/r1.claim: Ibn ʿUmar reports the Prophet’s saying that only two cases merit envy: a person given scripture who recites through the night and a wealthy person who gives charity night and day; al-Bukhārī alone transmits this route, while both Ṣaḥīḥs include a Sufyān route from al-Zuhrī.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p65#2/r1.anchor: أن عبد الله بن عمر قال: سمعت رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: " لا حسد

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p65#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p65#2/r2.speaker: أبو هريرة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p65#2/r2.claim: Abū Hurayra reports the Prophet’s parallel saying: one taught the Qurʾan recites it night and day, and one given wealth spends it for the right; neighbors wish they could do likewise.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p65#2/r2.anchor: عن أبي هريرة؛ " أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "لا حسد إلا في اثنتين

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r1.claim: The messenger between God and Muḥammad was Gabriel, a noble and honored angel; Ibn Kathīr says God praised both Gabriel and Muḥammad and cites descriptions of them in the Qurʾan.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r1.anchor: أن السفير بين الله وبين محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم جبريل عليه السلام وهو ملك كريم ذو وجاهة وجلالة ومكانة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r2.claim: Ibn Kathīr notes a virtue for Umm Salama, who saw Gabriel, and for the handsome Dihya b. Khalīfa al-Kalbī, whose appearance Gabriel often assumed when visiting the Prophet.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r2.anchor: فضيلة عظيمة لأم سلمة، رضي الله عنها -كما بينه مسلم رحمه الله-لرؤيتها لهذا الملك العظيم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r3.claim: Dihya and Usāma b. Zayd were affiliated with Kalb b. Wabara of Quḍāʿa; Quḍāʿa was variously said to descend from ʿAdnān, from Qaḥṭān, or to be an independent branch, and Ibn Kathīr leaves the matter to God.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r3.anchor: وهم قبيلة من قضاعة، وقضاعة قيل: إنهم من عدنان، وقيل: من قحطان

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r4.speaker: أبو هريرة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r4.claim: Abū Hurayra reports the Prophet saying every prophet received a sign by which people believed, while Muḥammad’s gift was revelation from God; he hopes to have the greatest following on Resurrection Day, and Ibn Kathīr notes its transmission by al-Bukhārī, Muslim, and al-Nasāʾī.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p19/r4.anchor: قال النبي (1) صلى الله عليه وسلم: "ما من الأنبياء نبي إلا أعطي ما مثله آمن عليه البشر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r3.speaker: الطحاوي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r3.claim: Al-Ṭaḥāwī and others explain the seven-language allowance as a concession because many people struggled with Quraysh speech, lacking writing, precise notation, and secure memorization.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r3.anchor: قال الطحاوي. وغيره: وإنما كان ذلك رخصة أن يقرأ الناس القرآن على سبع لغات

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r4.speaker: الطحاوي والقاضي الباقلاني وأبو عمرو بن عبد البر
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r4.claim: Al-Ṭaḥāwī, al-Bāqillānī, and Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr hold that the early concession to recite in seven dialects was later abrogated once hardship ended and memorization, precision, and writing spread.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r4.anchor: وقد ادعى الطحاوي والقاضي الباقلاني والشيخ أبو عمرو بن عبد البر أن ذلك كان رخصة في أول الأمر، ثم نسخ

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r5.speaker: بعضهم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r5.claim: One view says ʿUthmān consolidated the community on one reading and final recension because variation risked division and mutual accusations of unbelief, then prohibited other readings despite the former concession.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r5.anchor: جمعهم على قراءة واحدة أمير المؤمنين عثمان بن عفان، رضي الله عنه، أحد الخلفاء الراشدين

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r6.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r6.claim: The same account compares ʿUthmān’s action with ʿUmar enforcing triple divorce after its repeated use, restricting pilgrimage-season tamattuʿ to keep visits to the Kaʿba from being confined to pilgrimage months, and Abū Mūsā’s obedience in ceasing his fatwa.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r6.anchor: كما ألزم عمر بن الخطاب الناس بالطلاق الثلاثة المجموعة حين تتابعوا فيها وأكثروا منها

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r7.speaker: الخطابي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r7.claim: A second view says the Qurʾan’s seven aḥruf do not mean every passage is recited in all seven; different passages may occur in different forms. Al-Khaṭṭābī gives 5:60 and 12:12 as examples.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r8.speaker: أبو عبيد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r8.claim: Al-Qurṭubī says Abū ʿUbayd held this distributed-form view and Ibn ʿAṭiyya selected it; Abū ʿUbayd adds that some dialects fit particular expressions better than others.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r8.anchor: قال القرطبي: ذهب إلى هذا القول أبو عبيد، واختاره ابن عطية. قال أبو عبيد

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r9.speaker: القاضي الباقلاني
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r9.claim: Al-Bāqillānī says ʿUthmān’s statement that it was revealed in Quraysh speech means most of it, not all: no proof establishes that every word is Qurashī, since Arabic includes all tribes; Ibn ʿAbd al-Barr agrees.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r9.anchor: قال القاضي الباقلاني: ومعنى قول عثمان: إنه نزل بلسان قريش، أي: معظمه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r10.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r10.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r10.claim: Ibn ʿAṭiyya cites Ibn ʿAbbās, who says he learned فاطر from an Arab describing a well he had begun digging as one he had fathomed or started.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p45/r10.anchor: قال ابن عباس: ما كنت أدري ما معنى: {فاطر السماوات والأرض}

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r1.claim: Jurists unanimously permit debts in fungible goods such as currency, wheat, and barley.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r1.anchor: واتفقوا على جوازها فيما له مثل، نحو الدراهم والدنانير والحنطة والشعير

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r2.speaker: الأكثر
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r2.claim: Most jurists disallow deferred debt in nonfungible goods such as animals and clothing.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r2.anchor: فأما الذي لا مثل له كالحيوان والثياب فعند الأكثر لا يجوز

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r3.speaker: بعضهم
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r3.claim: Some jurists permit deferred debt in nonfungible goods.

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r4.claim: Jurists agree that obligations owed on liability may have a deferred term; specific assets cannot be deferred.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r4.anchor: واتفقوا أن ما يكون في الذمة يقبل الآجال، فأما الأعيان فلا تقبل الآجال

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r5.claim: The term must be known: that is the force of specified, and an unknown term defeats the purpose of writing and witnessing.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r5.anchor: لذلك قال: مسمى، وهو يفيد كونه معلوما، ولأن الغرض بالكتابة والإشهاد الطلب

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r6.claim: Writing and witnessing are guidance and recommendation, not obligation, since a creditor may waive the right itself and need not document it as a precaution.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r6.anchor: فالأقرب أنه إرشاد وندب غير واجب؛ لأن لصاحب الحق أن يسقط حقه أصلا

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r7.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r7.claim: Another view makes writing a collective duty when a group is present, and an individual duty when only one writer is available.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r7.anchor: وقد قيل: إنه إن كان هناك جماعة فهو فرض على الكفاية، وإن كان واحد تعين عليه

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r8.claim: The debt cannot be demanded before its due date; otherwise specifying a term would have no effect.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r8.anchor: أن الدين لا يجب المطالبة به قبل الأجل، لولا ذلك لم يفد الأجل

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r9.claim: A debt is legally due even though the demand for payment is deferred.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r9.anchor: أن الدين واجب، وإن تأخرت المطالبة

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r10.claim: The verse prescribes fair drafting of contract terms and documents and forbids harming either party.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r10.anchor: وتدل على كيفية كتب الشرائط والوثائق، حيث أمر بكتابته بالعدل، وحذر من الإضرار بأحدهما

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r11.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r11.claim: The scribe must have enough expertise to distinguish fair documentation from unfair terms.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r11.anchor: وتدل على أن الكاتب يجب أن يكون من أهل المعرفة حتى يميز العدل من غيره

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r12.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r12.claim: The debtor must acknowledge the debt and bear witness against himself; the parties need document only enough testimony for reliable assurance.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r12.anchor: فليملل يدل على أن من عليه الحق يجب أن يقر به، ويشهد على نفسه، ولا خلاف في وجوب الإقرار والإشهاد مقدار ما يتوثق به

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r13.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r13.claim: The incapacity clauses identify cases that prevent a valid acknowledgment by the debtor.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r13.anchor: فإن كان الذي عليه الحق سفيها يدل عليه؛ لأن جميع ذلك إنما يمنع الإقرار وصحته

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r14.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r14.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r14.claim: Acknowledgments are accepted and acted upon, and testimony can be given about them just as about deferred debts.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r14.anchor: وتدل على أن الإقرار مقبول معمول به، وأن الشهادة تقع عليه كما تقع على المداينات

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r15.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r15.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r15.claim: The acknowledgment of an incapable or weak debtor is not accepted; his guardian dictates in his place.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r15.anchor: وتدل على أن إقرار السفيه والضعيف لا يقبل

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r16.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r16.speaker: قيل
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r16.claim: Some treat foolishness, weakness, and inability as three distinct causes; others treat them as one condition, with a guardian dictating in either case.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r16.anchor: ثم منهم من حمل الجميع على أمر واحد، ومنهم من جعلها أمورا متغايرة تغاير الأسباب الثلاثة

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r17.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r17.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r17.claim: There is no disagreement that a minor or an insane person's acknowledgment is invalid.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r17.anchor: ولا خلاف أن إقرار الصغير والمجنون لا يصح

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r18.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r18.speaker: أهل العراق
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r18.claim: Iraqi jurists accept the acknowledgment of a financially profligate person after interdiction.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r18.anchor: فأما إقرار المبذر فيقبل عند أهل العراق

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r19.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r19.speaker: الشافعي
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r19.claim: Al-Shafi‘i does not accept a profligate person's acknowledgment after interdiction.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r19.anchor: وعند الشافعي لا يقبل، وهذا بعد الحجر

JISHUMI:v2p1078/r20.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r20.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r20.claim: The author construes the foolish debtor as insane, the weak as a minor, and the unable speaker as mute or similarly unable.
JISHUMI:v2p1078/r20.anchor: فوجب أن يحمل السفيه على المجنون، والضعيف على الصغير، ومن لا يستطيع على الأخرس ومن في معناه

JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r1.speaker: العامة
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r1.claim: The common reading has the imperative lām in وليكتب with sukūn.

JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r2.speaker: الحسن
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r2.claim: Al-Ḥasan reads the lām in وليكتب with kasra.

JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r3.claim: The lām is an imperative; when preceded by waw, fa, or thumma, most Arabs give it sukūn for ease, while others preserve its original kasra.
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r3.anchor: وهذه لام الأمر، ولا يؤمر به غير الغائب

JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r4.speaker: حمزة
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r4.claim: Ḥamza reads the hamza of إن with kasra and فتذكر with indicative mood and shadda; he construes the phrase conditionally and as a new clause after the conditional fa.
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r4.anchor: وقرأ حمزة إن تضل بكسر الألف فتذكر بالرفع والتشديد

JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r5.claim: In Ḥamza’s reading, تضل is jussive in the conditional though its doubling obscures the form; فتذكر is indicative as the clause after the conditional fa begins anew.
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r5.anchor: موضع تضل جزم بالجزاء إلا أنه لا يبين في التضعيف فتذكر رفع

JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r6.speaker: الباقون
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r6.claim: The other readers use fatḥ on أن and read فتذكر in connection with the preceding clause, with نصب either as the object of the verb or after an understood preposition أن.
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r6.anchor: وقرأ الباقون بنصب الألف والراء على الاتصال بالكلام الأول

JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r7.speaker: نافع وعاصم والكسائي وابن عامر
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r7.claim: Nāfiʿ, ʿĀṣim, al-Kisāʾī, and Ibn ʿĀmir read فتذكر with shadda and نصب; Ḥamza uses shadda and رفع, while Ibn Kathīr and Abū ʿAmr use a light form with نصب.
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r7.anchor: التشديد والنصب نافع وعاصم والكسائي وابن عامر، وبالتشديد والرفع حمزة

JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r8.claim: The light and doubled forms are both Arabic usage, like dhakkara/adhkara and nazzala/anzala.
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r8.anchor: وهما لغتان نحو ذكر وأذكر، ونزل وأنزل

JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r9.speaker: عاصم والجحدري
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r9.claim: ʿĀṣim and al-Jaḥdarī read تضل with passive morphology, ḍamma on the yāʾ and fatḥ on the ḍād.
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r9.anchor: وعن عاصم والجحدري تضل بضم الياء وفتح الضاد على المجهول

JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r10.speaker: زيد بن أسلم
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r10.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam reads فتذاكر with an alif, as reciprocal discussion.
JISHUMI:v2p1070#2/r10.anchor: وعن زيد بن أسلم فتذاكر بالألف من المذاكرة

JISHUMI:v2p1074/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r1.claim: The phrase can be parsed as a circumstantial clause, or as a predicate of an elided كان: ‘whether the debt is small or large.’
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r1.anchor: قلنا: لوجهين: أحدهما: على الحال، والثاني: أن تجعله خبرا ل (كان)

JISHUMI:v2p1074/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r2.claim: After forbidding usury, God permits salam and debts; after commanding respite, he also commands fulfillment before documentation and witnesses.
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r2.anchor: لما حرم تعالى الربا رخص في السلم والمداينات، فلما أمر بالإنظار أمر بالاستيفاء

JISHUMI:v2p1074/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r3.claim: Jishumi glosses the address as a call to affirm God and his messenger.
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r3.anchor: يا أيها الذين آمنوا صدقوا الله ورسوله

JISHUMI:v2p1074/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r4.claim: Tadayantum means that people deal with one another by lending or incurring a debt.
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r4.anchor: إذا تداينتم أي داين بعضكم بعضا يعني أعطاه دينا بدين

JISHUMI:v2p1074/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r5.claim: The word ‘debt’ is repeated because tadaayantum can mean either mutual repayment or dealings involving debt, so the repetition disambiguates the shared expression.
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r5.anchor: ذكر الدين مع المداينة لوجهين: أحدهما: تخليص المشترك

JISHUMI:v2p1074/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r6.claim: The repetition also reinforces the meaning in the mind, as in the emphatic Qur’anic phrases about the angels prostrating and birds flying with wings.
JISHUMI:v2p1074/r6.anchor: الثاني: التأكيد على جهة تمكين المعنى في النفس

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r1.claim: A specified term is a stated and known time.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r1.anchor: إلى أجل مسمى وقت مسمى، وقيل: نزلت الآية خاصة في السلم

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the verse was revealed specifically about salam sales.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r2.anchor: وقيل: نزلت الآية خاصة في السلم، عن ابن عباس

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r3.speaker: المفسرون والفقهاء
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r3.claim: The exegetes and jurists apply the verse to every debt and sale price, whether the sold item is delivered now or later.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r3.anchor: في كل دين وثمن بمبيع مسلم وغيره، وعليه المفسرون والفقهاء

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r4.claim: Mussammā means that the term is stated and known.

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r5.claim: Writing down the debt prevents later forgetfulness or denial.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r5.anchor: فاكتبوه أي اكتبوا الدين؛ لئلا يقع فيه نسيان أو جحود

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r6.speaker: أبو سعيد الخدري والحسن
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r6.claim: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī and al-Ḥasan, with most scholars, treat writing the debt as recommended.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r6.anchor: فقيل: هو ندب، عن أبي سعيد الخدري والحسن وعليه الأكثر

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r7.speaker: الربيع وكعب
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r7.claim: Al-Rabīʿ and Kaʿb regard writing the debt as obligatory.

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r8.speaker: الشعبي
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r8.claim: Al-Shaʿbī reports that writing, witnessing, and pledging were once obligatory and were abrogated by the following verse’s allowance when parties trust each other; Jishumi prefers the view that writing is recommended as a means of securing rights.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r8.anchor: كانت الكتابة والإشهاد والرهن واجبا فنسخ بقوله تعالى: فإن أمن بعضكم بعضا الآية، عن الشعبي

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r9.claim: The scribe records the debt or sale between the parties with fairness, neither adding nor subtracting nor harming either without their knowledge.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r9.anchor: يعني وليكتب كتاب المداينة أو البيع بين المتعاقدين كاتب بالعدل أي بالحق والإنصاف

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r10.speaker: الشعبي وجماعة من المفسرين
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r10.claim: Al-Shaʿbī and other exegetes say writing is a communal obligation, like jihad; Jishumi says this is the view followed in practice.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r10.anchor: قيل: الكتابة واجبة على الكفاية كالجهاد ونحوه، عن الشعبي وجماعة من المفسرين

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r11.speaker: السدي
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r11.claim: Al-Suddī says the duty applies to the scribe when he is free to write.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r11.anchor: وقيل: واجب على الكاتب في حال فراغه، عن السدي

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r12.speaker: مجاهد وعطاء والربيع
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r12.claim: Mujāhid, ʿAṭāʾ, and al-Rabīʿ say writing is obligatory when the scribe is asked.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r12.anchor: وقيل: واجب إذا أمر، عن مجاهد وعطاء والربيع

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r13.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r13.claim: Some say the command that a scribe not refuse was abrogated by the instruction not to harm a scribe or witness; the adopted practice is the first view, communal obligation.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r13.anchor: قيل: نسختها: ولا يضار كاتب ولا شهيد والعمل على القول الأول

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r14.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r14.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r14.claim: Writing is emphasized because scribes were few in the Prophet’s time.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r14.anchor: وكانت الكتبة فيهم قلة على عهد رسول الله

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r15.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r15.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r15.claim: The debtor should dictate by acknowledging in his own words what he owes, so the amount due is known.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r15.anchor: يعني المطلوب المديون يقر على نفسه بلسانه ليعلم ما عليه

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r16.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r16.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r16.claim: The debtor must avoid disobeying God’s command and must not reduce any part of the debt.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r16.anchor: أي يتقي مخالفة أمره ولا يبخس منه شيئا لا ينقص من الحق شيئا

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r17.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r17.speaker: مجاهد
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r17.claim: Mujāhid glosses safīh as someone ignorant about dictation.

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r18.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r18.speaker: السدي والضحاك
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r18.claim: Al-Suddī and al-Ḍaḥḥāk gloss safīh as a young child.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r18.anchor: وقيل: طفلا صغيرا عن السدي والضحاك

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r19.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r19.speaker: ابن زيد
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r19.claim: Ibn Zayd glosses safīh as incapable or foolish.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r19.anchor: وقيل: عاجزا أحمق، عن ابن زيد

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r20.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r20.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r20.claim: Weak is explained as sick or senile with age; unable to dictate includes muteness, foreign speech, or similar inability.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r20.anchor: قيل: مريضا، وقيل: شيخا خرفا أو لا يستطيع أن يمل هو، أي لا يقدر على الإملاء لخرس أو عجمة

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r21.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r21.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r21.claim: Jishumi says the three categories should be understood as distinct to avoid repetition: mentally disabled, young, and unable to dictate, with comparable cases included under each.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r21.anchor: الأقرب أن يحمل على ثلاث صفات لكيلا يؤدي إلى التكرار

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r22.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r22.speaker: القاضي
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r22.claim: The Qāḍī’s preferred mapping is a spendthrift for safīh, an adolescent child for weak, and an insane person as unable to dictate; each label may include equivalents.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r22.anchor: السفيه: المبذر، والضعيف: الصبي المراهق، ومن لا يستطيع أن يمل المجنون عن القاضي

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r23.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r23.speaker: الضحاك وابن زيد
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r23.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk and Ibn Zayd say the guardian of the incompetent person dictates what that person owes, acting in his place.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r23.anchor: ولي السفيه يملي ما على السفيه، فيقوم مقامه، عن الضحاك وابن زيد

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r24.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r24.speaker: ابن عباس والربيع ومقاتل
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r24.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās, al-Rabīʿ, and Muqātil identify the guardian as the creditor, who knows the debt and dictates it fairly.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r24.anchor: وقيل: ولي الحق، عن ابن عباس والربيع ومقاتل؛ لأنه أعلم بدينه

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r25.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r25.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r25.claim: The instruction is to seek witnesses and have them testify to the written record; two men suffice generally, except that adultery requires four.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r25.anchor: يعني اطلبوا الشهود وأشهدوا على المكتوب، شهيدين يعني رجلين

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r26.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r26.speaker: مجاهد وجماعة من الفقهاء
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r26.claim: Mujāhid and many jurists restrict the male witnesses to free, adult Muslims, excluding non-Muslims, slaves, and children.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r26.anchor: قيل: من الأحرار البالغين المسلمين دون الكفار والعبيد والصبيان، عن مجاهد وجماعة من الفقهاء

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r27.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r27.speaker: شريح وابن سيرين
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r27.claim: Shurayḥ and Ibn Sīrīn permit testimony by slaves.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r27.anchor: وأجاز شريح وابن سيرين شهادة العبيد

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r28.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r28.speaker: مالك
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r28.claim: Mālik permits children’s testimony in cases of assault injuries.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r28.anchor: وأجاز مالك شهادة الصبيان في الجراح

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r29.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r29.speaker: مالك والأوزاعي والشافعي
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r29.claim: Mālik, al-Awzāʿī, and al-Shāfiʿī restrict the male-and-two-women arrangement to financial matters.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r29.anchor: قيل: هذا في الأموال خاصة، عن مالك والأوزاعي والشافعي

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r30.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r30.speaker: أهل العراق
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r30.claim: Iraqi jurists apply it to all matters except fixed criminal penalties and retaliation.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r30.anchor: الحدود والقصاص، وهو قول أهل العراق

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r31.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r31.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r31.claim: Acceptable witnesses are upright in religion, trustworthy, and competent; another gloss requires that no suspicion or accusation attach to them.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r31.anchor: يعني من كان مرضيا في دينه وأمانته وكفايته وهو العدل

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r32.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r32.speaker: إبراهيم
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r32.claim: Ibrāhīm defines an acceptable witness as someone who has not shown cause for suspicion.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r32.anchor: وقيل: العدل المرضي من لم يظهر منه ريبة، عن إبراهيم

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r33.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r33.speaker: الشعبي
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r33.claim: Al-Shaʿbī describes a trustworthy witness as one not accused in matters of appetite or sexual conduct.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r33.anchor: وقيل: من لم يطعن عليه في بطن ولا فرج، عن الشعبي

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r34.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r34.speaker: الربيع والسدي والضحاك وابن زيد
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r34.claim: Al-Rabīʿ, al-Suddī, al-Ḍaḥḥāk, Ibn Zayd, and most exegetes take ‘go astray’ as forget, so one woman reminds the other of the testimony.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r34.anchor: قيل: هو من الذكر أي تذكرها الشهادة، عن الربيع والسدي والضحاك وابن زيد وأكثر المفسرين

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r35.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r35.speaker: سفيان بن عيينة
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r35.claim: Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna instead understands the reminder as making one woman like a male witness.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r35.anchor: وقيل: من الذكر أي تجعلها كذكر من الرجال، عن سفيان بن عيينة

JISHUMI:v2p1075/r36.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r36.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r36.claim: Jishumi rejects the ‘make her like a man’ gloss because the preceding condition that one may err indicates that reminder means recalling the testimony.
JISHUMI:v2p1075/r36.anchor: وهذا يبعد لأنه تقدم قوله: (تضل) فدل أن المراد به الذكر

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r1.speaker: مجاهد وعطاء والشعبي والسدي وسعيد بن جبير
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r1.claim: Mujāhid, ʿAṭāʾ, al-Shaʿbī, al-Suddī, and Saʿīd ibn Jubayr take the call as one to give testimony in court; the Qāḍī chooses this view.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r1.anchor: لإقامتها، عن مجاهد وعطاء والشعبي والسدي وسعيد بن جبير، وهو الذي اختاره القاضي

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r2.speaker: ابن عباس والحسن
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās and al-Ḥasan understand the call to cover both bearing and giving testimony.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r2.anchor: لإثباتها وإقامتها، عن ابن عباس والحسن

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r3.claim: Some reject interpreting the call as bearing testimony because the people have not yet become witnesses; Jishumi answers that the command to seek two witnesses makes them witnesses.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r3.anchor: وأنكر بعضهم حمل الآية على التحمل؛ لأنهم ليسوا بشهداء، وهذا الاحتجاج يبطل بقوله: واستشهدوا شهيدين

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r4.claim: If the verse concerns bearing testimony, that duty is variously described as communal obligation, recommendation, or permission; if giving testimony, it is communal when others can do it and individual when no substitute exists.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r4.anchor: فقيل: واجب على الكفاية، وقيل: هو أمر ندب، وقيل: هو إباحة

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r5.claim: Do not tire of documenting the debt, whether small or large, and continue through its due date; another view refers to the witness’s term.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r5.anchor: لا تملوا أن تكتبوه صغيرا كان الحق أو كبيرا قليلا كان المال أو كبيرا

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r6.claim: The term is explained as the due date of the debt or, alternatively, the witness’s term.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r6.anchor: إلى أجله يعني محل الدين والحق، وقيل: إلى أجل الشاهد

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r7.claim: The writing is more just before God because he commanded it, and obeying his command is more just than leaving it; it is also sounder for testimony and nearer to removing doubt.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r7.anchor: واتباع أمره أعدل من تركه وأقوم للشهادة

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r8.claim: The exception is an immediate cash sale, hand to hand, with no deferred term; documenting it is not required and causes no harm or financial burden.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r8.anchor: تجارة حاضرة يدا بيد نقدا غير نسيئة ولا فيه أجل

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r9.speaker: الضحاك
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r9.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk considers witnessing a sale obligatory.

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r10.speaker: الحسن والشافعي
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r10.claim: Al-Ḥasan and al-Shāfiʿī regard witnessing sales as recommended, which Jishumi says is the jurists’ position.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r10.anchor: وقيل: ندب، عن الحسن والشافعي، وهو قول الفقهاء

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r11.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r11.claim: On the active reading, the underlying form is yudārir with kasra; the writer and witness are the agents.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r11.anchor: أصله ولا يضارر، بكسر الراء، والفاعل الكاتب والشهيد

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r12.speaker: عطاء وطاووس والحسن وقتادة وابن زيد
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r12.claim: The writer must not be harmed by being forbidden to write or made to add or subtract from what was dictated; the witness must not be made to refuse or testify to what he does not know.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r12.anchor: لا يضار كاتب بألا يكتب، أو يكتب ما لم يملل بزيادة أو نقصان

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r13.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r13.claim: On the passive reading, the writer and witness are the objects of harm.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r13.anchor: وقيل: هو على الفعل المجهول والكاتب والشهيد مفعولان

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r14.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r14.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r14.claim: The passive reading means not to burden a writer or witness when called for an important need; another person should be summoned if possible.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r14.anchor: يعني لا يضارر بفتح الراء: الكاتب والشاهد إذا دعوا، وهما على حاجة مهمة

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r15.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r15.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r15.claim: The forbidden conduct is understood as harming the writer and witness or doing what was prohibited and disobeying what was commanded; it is departure from God’s obedience.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r15.anchor: قيل: ما نهيتكم عنه من الضرار، وقيل: إن تفعلوا ما نهيتكم به

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r16.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r16.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r16.claim: Taqwā here means avoiding disobedience and sin, or safeguarding trusts by discharging them.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r16.anchor: يعني اتقوا مخالفة أمره والفسوق، وقيل: اتقوا في الأمانات ألا تؤدوها

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r17.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r17.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r17.claim: God teaches people what benefits them in religious and worldly affairs, which they did not know.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r17.anchor: ما فيه صلاحكم في أمر دينكم ودنياكم ما لم تعلموا

JISHUMI:v2p1077/r18.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r18.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r18.claim: God’s knowledge is glossed as universal, knowledge of people’s deeds and recompense, or knowledge of their interests that informs his commands and prohibitions.
JISHUMI:v2p1077/r18.anchor: قيل: هو عام أي عالم بجميع الأشياء لا يخفى عليه شيء

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r1.speaker: العامة
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r1.claim: The common reading uses second-person feminine/masculine address in لا تسأموا.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r1.anchor: وقراءة العامة: لا تسأموا بالتاء على الخطاب

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r2.speaker: السلمي
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r2.claim: Al-Sulami reads لا يسأموا with yāʾ, referring back to the preceding past context.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r2.anchor: وعن السلمي لا يسأموا بالياء رجوعا إلى الماضي

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r3.speaker: عاصم
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r3.claim: Asim reads تجارة in the accusative as the predicate of كان, with an omitted subject: unless the trade is a trade.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r3.anchor: قرأ عاصم بنصب تجارة على أنه خبر كان، وأضمر الاسم

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r4.claim: For the nominative reading, one analysis supplies تقع: unless a trade occurs.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r4.anchor: وقرأ الباقون بالرفع على وجهين: أحدهما: إلا أن تقع تجارة

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r5.claim: Another nominative analysis makes تجارة the subject of كان and the following clause its predicate, meaning a trade circulating among you.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r5.anchor: والثاني: أن تجعل اسم كان في التجارة والخبر في الفعل، وهو تديرونها

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r6.speaker: أبو جعفر
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r6.claim: Abu Jaʿfar reads يضار in the jussive with a light, ungeminated rāʾ.

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r7.speaker: الحسن
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r7.claim: Al-Hasan reads يضار with a kasra and a geminated rāʾ.

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r8.speaker: العامة
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r8.claim: The common reading has the accusative and gemination; its form derives from لا تضارر with two r's assimilated.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r8.anchor: وقراءة العامة بالنصب والتشديد؛ لأن أصله لا تضارر براءين

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r9.claim: Al-dayn is an obligation established in the debtor's liability, and al-ajal is the appointed time, or the time's end.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r9.anchor: الدين: ما ثبت في الذمة، داين مداينة. والأجل: الوقت، وقيل: انقضاء الوقت

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r10.claim: Imlāʾ and imlāl are two forms for dictating; imlāl fundamentally means repeating something again and again.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r10.anchor: والإملاء والإملال لغتان، أملى يملي إملاء، ومنه (فهي تملى عليه بكرة وأصيلا (5).

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r11.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r11.claim: Bakhṣ means unjustly diminishing something, as in depriving someone of his due.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r11.anchor: والبخس: النقص ظلما، بخسه حقه، ومنه: (بثمن بخس).

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r12.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r12.claim: Safah means ignorance, with its root sense being lightness; the term describes a lightness of intellect.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r12.anchor: والسفه: الجهل، وأصله من الخفة، سمي بذلك لخفة عقله

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r13.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r13.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r13.claim: Saʾam means weariness or boredom, becoming annoyed with something.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r13.anchor: والسأم: الملل، سأم يسأم سأما إذا مل من الشيء وضجر منه

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r14.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r14.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r14.claim: Ḍalāl originally means destruction; Arabic says water was lost in milk, and the Qurʾan also uses it for the criminals' ruin.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r14.anchor: والضلال: أصله الهلاك تقول العرب: ضل الماء في اللبن، ومنه: (إن المجرمين في ضلال وسعر (47).

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r15.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r15.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r15.claim: Another proposed root sense of ḍalāl is going away so completely that one cannot be found, as in the question about being lost in the earth.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r15.anchor: وقيل: أصله الذهاب بحيث لا يوجد، ومنه: (أإذا ضللنا في الأرض).

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r16.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r16.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r16.claim: Ibaʾ means refusing or refraining from something, as in Iblis's refusal.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r16.anchor: والإباء: الامتناع من الشيء أبي يأبى إباء، ومنه: (إلا إبليس أبى).

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r17.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r17.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r17.claim: Qisṭ means justice and derives from turning toward the truth; aqsaṭa describes acting justly.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r17.anchor: والقسط: العدل، وأصله العدول؛ لأنه عدول إلى الحق، وأقسط فهو مقسط

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r18.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r18.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r18.claim: Adnā derives from nearness and means closer; al-dunyā is named for being nearer than the hereafter.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r18.anchor: وأدنى: من الدنو، وهو القرب، ومنه الدنيا؛ لأنها أقرب من الآخرة

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r19.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r19.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r19.claim: Irtiyāb is doubt arising from suspicion.

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r20.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r20.speaker: علي بن عيسى
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r20.claim: Ali ibn ʿIsa gives four sound expansions for the nominative phrase: let there be witnesses, let a man and two women testify, the witnesses are these, or they testify.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r20.anchor: ذكره علي بن عيسى، ويجوز فيه النصب على تقدير: فاستشهدوا رجلا وامرأتين.

JISHUMI:v2p1071/r21.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r21.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r21.claim: The phrase may instead be accusative, with an implied command to summon one man and two women as witnesses.
JISHUMI:v2p1071/r21.anchor: ويجوز فيه النصب على تقدير: فاستشهدوا رجلا وامرأتين

JISHUMI:v2p1073/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r1.speaker: سيبويه
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r1.claim: Sibawayh explains that straying is stated before reminding because it causes the reminder; the connected actions function as one purpose, as in propping a wall because it is leaning.
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r1.anchor: قول سيبويه: لما كان الضلال سببا للإذكار قدم لذلك فصار - من أجل تعلق أحدهما بالآخر - في حكم واحد

JISHUMI:v2p1073/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r2.speaker: الفراء
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r2.claim: Al-Farrāʾ takes the phrase conditionally: one woman reminds the other if she strays; fronting أن makes it attach to the preceding governor.
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r2.anchor: قول الفراء، إنه بمعنى الجزاء، على أن تذكر إحداهما الأخرى إن ضلت

JISHUMI:v2p1073/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r3.claim: The pronoun in إلى أجله may refer to the debt's term or to the witness's term of eligibility; the debt's term is the stronger reading.
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r3.anchor: إلى أجل الدين. الثاني: إلى أجل الشاهد أي الوقت الذي لا يجوز فيه شهادته، والأول أوجه

JISHUMI:v2p1073/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r4.speaker: الحسن، وقتادة، وابن زيد
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r4.claim: The kasra reading of يضارر is associated with al-Hasan, Qatada, and Ibn Zayd.
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r4.anchor: قيل: يضارر بكسر الراء في معنى قول الحسن وقتادة وابن زيد

JISHUMI:v2p1073/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r5.speaker: ابن مسعود ومجاهد
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r5.claim: Ibn Masʿud and Mujahid are associated with the fatḥa reading, meaning a witness must not be summoned while occupied in order to harm him.
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r5.anchor: عن ابن مسعود ومجاهد، أي لا يدعى وهو مشغول على جهة الإضرار به

JISHUMI:v2p1073/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r6.claim: The two r's assimilate; the form is accusative because of gemination and the meeting of two sukūns, with fatḥa chosen as the lightest vowel.
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r6.anchor: أدغم أحد الراءين في الآخر، ونصب بحق التضعيف لاجتماع الساكنين، والفتح أخف الحركات

JISHUMI:v2p1073/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r7.claim: The final two lām letters remain distinct because the second is still quiescent in the imperative; when the lām is made mobile, as in يمل, assimilation occurs.
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r7.anchor: لأن الأخيرة ساكنة، وإذا سكنت الأخيرة لا تدغم كقولك اردد، ولو تحركت أدغمت كقولك: رد

JISHUMI:v2p1073/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r8.claim: Tartābū is on the tafaʿʿal pattern from rayba; its original yāʾ moved after a fatḥa and changed into a long alif.
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r8.anchor: تفتعلوا من الريبة، وأضله ترتيبوا إلا أن الياء لما تحركت وما قبلها مفتوح قلبتها ألفا ساكنة

JISHUMI:v2p1073/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r9.claim: The clause after أن is accusative either as an infinitive meaning its writing, or after deletion of the preposition من.
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r9.anchor: هو في محل النصب لوجهين: إن شئت جعلته مع الفعل مصدرا تقديره: ولا تسأموا كتابته

JISHUMI:v2p1073/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r10.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r10.claim: An alternative construction supplies the omitted preposition من: do not tire of writing it.
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r10.anchor: وإن شئت بنزع حرف الصفة تقديره: ولا تسأموا من أن تكتبوه

JISHUMI:v2p1073/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r11.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r11.claim: The pronoun in تكتبوه refers to the debt/right owed.
JISHUMI:v2p1073/r11.anchor: ويقال: إلى ماذا يجود الهاء في قوله: تكتبوه؟ قلنا: علىالحق.

JISHUMI:v2p1079/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r1.claim: The verse implies that rulers and judges must be appointed, since a fool's and a weak person's affairs cannot be managed without them.
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r1.anchor: وتدل الآية على وجوب نصب الولاة والحكام من حيث لا يتم أمر السفيه والضعيف إلا بهم

JISHUMI:v2p1079/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r2.claim: The command identifies witnesses, their number, method, and qualifications, and indicates a duty to establish testimony.
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r2.anchor: وقوله: واستشهدوا يدل على الشاهد وعدده وكيفيته وصفته ووجوب إقامة الشهادة

JISHUMI:v2p1079/r3.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r3.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r3.claim: Taking witnesses is guidance and recommendation in ordinary transactions; most jurists require witnesses for marriage, though Malik does not.
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r3.anchor: فأما الإشهاد فقد بينا أنه ندب وإرشاد، فأما في النكاح فواجب عند الأكثر، وقال مالك: لا يجب

JISHUMI:v2p1079/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r4.claim: Jurists agree that witnesses are not required for divorce, while Abu Hanifa does not require them for revocation and al-Shafiʿi does.
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r4.anchor: فأما في الطلاق فاتفقوا أنه لا يجب، واختلفوا في الرجعة فعند أبي حنيفة لا يجب، وعند الشافعي يجب

JISHUMI:v2p1079/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r5.claim: Two witnesses suffice for property claims, with no disagreement on this or on testimony in adultery cases.
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r5.anchor: فأما العدد فتدل أن في الأموال يحكم بشاهدين، ولا خلاف فيه وفي شهود الزنا

JISHUMI:v2p1079/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r6.claim: For matters that are neither property, a prescribed punishment, nor a defined right, Abu Hanifa accepts women's testimony while al-Shafiʿi rejects it.
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r6.anchor: فعند أبي حنيفة تقبل شهادة النساء، وعند الشافعي لا تقبل

JISHUMI:v2p1079/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r7.claim: Women alone may testify in matters men cannot observe, such as female defects, childbirth, and the newborn's first cry; jurists disagree about nursing.
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r7.anchor: فيما لا يطلع عليه الرجال من عيوب النساء والولادة والاستهلال، واختلفوا في الرضاع

JISHUMI:v2p1079/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r8.speaker: أبو حنيفة
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r8.claim: In fields where women's testimony alone is accepted, Abu Hanifa accepts one woman, while Muhammad requires four.
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r8.anchor: فعند أبي حنيفة كل موضع يقبل فيه قول النساء وحدهن يقبل قول واحدة، وعند محمد لا يقبل إلا قول أربع

JISHUMI:v2p1079/r9.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r9.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r9.claim: A witness should meet ten qualities: freedom, adulthood, Islam, integrity, knowledge of the testimony, no self-interest or self-protection, few errors, manly virtue, alertness, and not being heedless.
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r9.anchor: ويجب أن يجتمع فيه عشر خصال: الحرية، والبلوغ، والإسلام، والعدالة، وأن يكون عالما بما يشهد

JISHUMI:v2p1079/r10.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r10.speaker: أبو يوسف
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r10.claim: In an anecdote before al-Muʿtadid's vizier, judge Abu Hazim cites Abu Yusuf's definition of integrity: avoid major sins and persistence in minor ones, show more concealment than scandal and more correctness than error, display muruʾa, and restrain from lying through piety or honor.
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r10.anchor: قال لأبي حازم: قل أحسن ما قيل فيه. قال: قول أبي يوسف: إنه الذي لا يأتي الكبائر ولا يصر

JISHUMI:v2p1079/r11.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r11.speaker: أهل العراق
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r11.claim: Iraqi jurists accept the testimony of non-Muslims against one another; Malik and al-Shafiʿi do not.
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r11.anchor: وأما شهادة الكفار بعضهم على بعض فتقبل عند أهل العراق، ولا تقبل عند مالك والشافعي

JISHUMI:v2p1079/r12.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r12.speaker: أبو علي وأكثر الفقهاء
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r12.claim: Abu ʿAli and most jurists infer that judgment cannot rest on one witness plus an oath because that exceeds the divinely set limit; Abu Hashim and al-Shafiʿi permit it.
JISHUMI:v2p1079/r12.anchor: عن أبي علي وأكثر الفقهاء، وقيل: لا يمتنع، عن أبي هاشم، وهو قول الشافعي

JISHUMI:v2p1080/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1080/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1080/r1.claim: The instruction to avoid doubt means one must not testify while uncertain and should testify only with certainty.
JISHUMI:v2p1080/r1.anchor: أن الواجب ألا يشهد مع الارتياب، وأنه يشهد مع اليقين كما قال رسول الله

JISHUMI:v2p1080/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1080/r2.speaker: رسول الله
JISHUMI:v2p1080/r2.claim: The Prophet says: testify only if you know something as clearly as the sun; otherwise do not testify.
JISHUMI:v2p1080/r2.anchor: كما قال رسول الله - صلى الله عليه وسلم -: إن علمت مثل الشمس فاشهد وإلا فلا

JISHUMI:v2p1081/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1081/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1081/r1.claim: The author's teachers say causing harm becomes fisq when it reaches a major degree; a minor case incurs the warning but is not fisq.
JISHUMI:v2p1081/r1.anchor: فسوقا إذا بلغ حدا يكون كبيرا، فأما الصغير فدخله الوعيد وليس بفسوق.

JISHUMI:v2p1081/r2.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v2p1081/r2.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v2p1081/r2.claim: According to the author's school, fisq is a term of blame.
JISHUMI:v2p1081/r2.anchor: وتدل على أن الفسوق اسم ذم على ما نقوله.
